title: Deconstructed Beef and Pinto Bean Taco Bowls
intro: Turning a traditional taco into a bowl makes it easy to add extra fiber with crisp greens and brown rice. These base ingredients perfectly support the smoky, savory flavors of the lean beef.

ingredients.name: 96% lean ground beef
ingredients.canonical_name: Beef, ground, 96% lean meat / 4% fat, raw

ingredients.name: low-sodium beef broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, beef broth or bouillon, canned, ready-to-serve, low sodium

ingredients.name: ready-to-eat cooked brown rice (from a pouch)
no-salt-added canned pinto beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, pinto, mature seeds, canned, drained solids, no salt added

instructions: Heat extra-virgin olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add ground beef and salt-free taco seasoning. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, checking at 5 minutes, while breaking the meat apart with a wooden spoon.
Pour in beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, checking at 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Warm brown rice in the microwave according to package directions.
Divide chopped romaine lettuce between wide, shallow bowls.
Top the lettuce with the warmed brown rice, rinsed pinto beans, and seasoned beef.
Garnish each bowl with fresh pico de gallo, diced avocado, and chopped cilantro before serving.
variation: Swap the ground beef for extra-lean ground turkey breast.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; store the avocado and greens separately.
